prompt: Which Kiwi author died the same year as the first British Prime Minister to be elected after the end of World War 1?
answer: The Kiwi author was **Ursula Bethell**, the New Zealand poet and writer who died in **1945**—the same year as **David Lloyd George**, the British prime minister elected in the 1918 post–World War I general election.
